fusions.name: Broadside
fusions.desc: Looses 3 bolts of wind at once, spread apart, each dealing 8 damage and driving the target back 2 tiles.

fusions.name: Fair Run
fusions.desc: Sends a gust that deals 6 damage to the first enemy it meets. Its damage rises with the distance you have travelled. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Spreading Sail
fusions.desc: Increases your movement speed by 35% for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Gathering Pace
fusions.desc: Every hit you land builds a stack on you, up to 6. When you reach 6, they all spend at once: you move and attack 5% faster per stack (27% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
